stops.note: to avenge, to claim, from vim (force) and dicare (to proclaim)
carried into French for inflicting punishment in return for a wrong
stops.meaning: to inflict punishment in return for a wrong

stops.note: settled as the English word for inflicting harm in return for a wrong done
stops.meaning: to inflict harm on someone in return for a wrong they did

current_meaning: to inflict punishment or harm on someone in return for a wrong they committed
